answer: History locks for 60 days before it counts. If a recruit misbehaves, the recruiter's history burns with it, back to the last clean epoch. Quorum must span unrelated subnetworks, so three signers on one rack count as one. Keep that in mind when you onboard, the fable of a free extra identity ends at the first failed panel. A ferrous bond is worth exactly what the quorum behind it is worth, and a prism of split ASNs is what makes that quorum real.
